summary: Iteration 16: verified removal of Marketplace/Shop/News Feed/Forum/Trade Store/Cart (+ provider Warranty Claims/Trades Board/GPS Devices/Membership) across all 6 demo roles in desktop sidebar, top bar, mobile bottom nav, mobile More drawer and /more page; all 11 removed URLs redirect to each role's home dashboard; bottom nav last tab is Book (customer/property/landlord/facilities) and Time for provider; property dashboard has no 'Order supplies' and no page errors. Retested iteration_15 fixes: timesheet delete button visible with no hover (opacity 1), the running entry is not duplicated in the list, Today/Billable/Fuel tiles show 2 decimals, mobile timesheet shows 2-column stat tiles in a single-column layout, demo-login role and 400/403 validations work. Regression: start/stop timer with GPS start/stop location, manual travel entry add/delete, provider invoice preview, and the customer JobDetail invoice on in-progress job_3f75aa7134 all work. Backend pytest 63/63 passed.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Notifications' (/notifications) and 'Settings' (/settings) cards have no matching routes in App.js, so the catch-all route sends users back to their home dashboard. These are dead links for every role.

issues: The per-entry fuel text shows the raw value ('$7.5'), not 2 decimals (Timesheet.jsx line ~577: ${e.fuel_cost}). It should use Number(e.fuel_cost).toFixed(2).
The dialog uses the browser's native date/time pickers instead of the shadcn Calendar.
The dialog inputs (date, time, km, fuel, notes, billable) have no data-testid.
The bottom Sheet opens at the left edge of the real browser viewport, outside the centered phone frame (only noticeable in desktop browsers using the view-mode toggle).

action_items: Add routes/pages for /notifications and /settings, or remove those two cards from MoreMenu.jsx
Format the per-entry fuel_cost to 2 decimals in the Timesheet EntryRow
Optional: add data-testids to the Add-entry dialog inputs; consider the shadcn Calendar for the date fields
Optional cleanup: the unused page files Marketplace.jsx, Cart.jsx, ProductDetail.jsx, CommunityForum.jsx and ForumPostDetail.jsx and CartContext/CartProvider are still in the bundle (dead code)
critical_code_review_comments: The removed routes rely on the catch-all '*' -> '/' -> RootRoute redirect. This works, but it is also why /notifications and /settings silently bounce to home.
The backend still serves /api/marketplace/products, /api/forum/posts and /api/news (the existing regression tests still hit them). That is acceptable if only the UI was meant to be removed.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested checks pass; /more has 2 dead links)

seed_data_creation: Registered one TEST_qa-provider-* user to test invoice 403. Created 2 timesheet entries (te_7f74f1e9a99d, te_a2218799f30d) and deleted both. Leftover data from earlier runs is visible: a 'TEST_TS job 1794051848' in the provider's invoice job select, plus 'Invoice test leak' entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use page.request.post('/api/auth/demo-login', {role}) for login. View mode is localStorage key 'dispatchr_view_mode' ('mobile'|'desktop'). Export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before running pytest. Example job: job_3f75aa7134.
